observations.body: Jesus enters a garden, meets Judas and an armed party, identifies himself, protects his disciples, stops Peter’s sword, speaks of the cup, and is bound.
observations.label: Jesus steps forward; the arresting party falls back: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps jesus, judas, officers and disciples visible within its Crucifixion evidence.

payload.posture: Read John 18:1–12 as its own anticipation and stated approach crucifixion setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: This witness selects its own people, actions, words, and sequence around the Crucifixion without explaining every difference from the other witnesses.
